'''High Shaman''' was the title held by one of the three [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who led the nomadic tribes of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] before [[Tenebrae|Valkorion's]] arrival and the formation of the [[Eternal Empire]]. Each tribe was led by a [[Matriarch (Zakuul)|Matriarch]], [[Champion (Zakuul)|Champion]], and High Shaman, and after he united the tribes, Valkorion repurposed the three roles as the [[Knights of Zakuul]], an order of Force-sensitive warriors.<ref name="Codex" />
